source.title: Annual Members Meeting (September 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The Board is providing notice, as required by Bylaw 2.12, of the 2026 annual meeting of the members which will be held on September 27 at 17:00 UTC. Members will be able to tune into this meeting via a livestream hosted on the [WCA’s Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/worldcubeassociation). In this [folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MEVM0MChBjC5-gCXvQyJ5s2CqgB41RpX), you will find the information packet related to the annual meeting which contains all relevant documentation which will be discussed at the meeting.

<!-- break -->

We look forward to your participation in the upcoming annual meeting.

Kind Regards,
Oliver Hexter, on behalf of the Board of Directors

translation.title: 年度会员大会（2026 年 9 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

董事会依照章程第 2.12 条发出通知：2026 年年度会员大会将于 9 月 27 日 17:00 UTC 举行。会员可通过 [WCA Twitch 频道](https://www.twitch.tv/worldcubeassociation)的直播观看会议。在这个[文件夹](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MEVM0MChBjC5-gCXvQyJ5s2CqgB41RpX)中，您可以找到本次年度大会的资料包，其中包括所有将在会上讨论的相关文件。

我们期待您参与即将举行的年度大会。

此致，
Oliver Hexter，代表董事会
